services.title: Built for Early-Stage Startups
services.alt: Startup team gathered around a “Start It Up!” presentation
services.summary: Seed-stage investment and investor readiness for founders at the very beginning.
lead: Seed-stage investment and investor readiness for founders at the very beginning.
We invest in startups at their earliest stage when ideas are still forming but potential is highest.
services.note: Seed stage funding from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore, and the preparation to make the most of it.

items.title: Seed Stage Funding (₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore)
items.text: We provide seed stage investment ranging from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore to help founders transform innovative ideas into successful and scalable businesses.

items.title: Investment Readiness
items.text: We prepare startups for investment by strengthening their business model, refining their strategy, and ensuring they are ready to confidently engage with investors.

items.title: Pitch Evaluation
items.text: We review and evaluate pitch decks, business plans, and presentations, providing constructive feedback to help founders communicate their vision and investment opportunity effectively.

items.title: Due Diligence Support
items.text: We help founders organize the financial, legal, and operational documentation required during the investment process, ensuring they are well prepared for investor evaluation and due diligence.

services.title: Investment Solutions
services.alt: Two business partners in suits shaking hands
services.summary: Helping founders secure the capital and preparation they need to build and grow.
lead: Helping founders secure the capital and preparation they need to build and grow.

Capital is the foundation of every successful venture. We invest ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore to help founders transform innovative ideas into scalable businesses. Our investment provides more than funding by supporting long-term growth from the very beginning.
services.note: ₹10 Lakhs – ₹1 Crore per investment. We review every application personally and respond within 7 working days.

items.title: Submit Your Pitch
items.text: Share your business plan, vision, and funding requirements. We review your application personally and respond within 7 working days.

items.title: Due Diligence & Alignment
items.text: We evaluate market potential, founder-market fit, and growth trajectory. If there’s alignment, we structure an investment between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore.

items.title: Partner for Growth
items.text: Once the investment is finalized, we become your long-term partner. Beyond capital, we provide strategic guidance, national and international market access, and mentorship to help you build, grow, and scale your business.

services.title: Business Formation & Facilitation
services.alt: Hand signing a business registration document with a fountain pen
services.summary: Establishing a strong operational foundation for your business.
lead: Establishing a strong operational foundation for your business.
services.note: From registration to the vendors and partners that keep a business running.

items.title: Company Registration
items.text: We assist founders in selecting the appropriate business structure and completing the company registration process, ensuring a smooth and compliant business setup.

items.title: Compliance & Documentation
items.text: We help businesses meet statutory and regulatory requirements by managing essential documentation, registrations, and ongoing compliance obligations.

items.title: Banking & Financial Setup
items.text: We support founders in establishing business banking, payment systems, and financial processes to ensure efficient business operations from day one.

items.title: Business Licensing
items.text: We assist in obtaining the licenses, permits, and registrations required to legally establish and operate your business.

items.title: Business Operations Support
items.text: We provide operational guidance and support to help businesses streamline processes, improve efficiency, and build a strong foundation for sustainable growth.

items.title: Vendor & Strategic Partner Connections
items.text: We connect founders with trusted vendors, service providers, and strategic partners who can support business operations, growth, and long term success.

services.title: Strategic Business Consulting
services.alt: Team fitting large puzzle pieces together on a table
services.summary: Expert guidance to help founders make confident business decisions.
lead: Expert guidance to help founders make confident business decisions.
services.note: Strategy, models, finance and risk — the decisions that shape a growing business.

items.title: Business Strategy
items.text: We help founders define clear business objectives, develop competitive strategies, and create actionable plans that drive sustainable growth.

items.title: Business Model Development
items.text: We work with entrepreneurs to design and refine business models that are scalable, sustainable, and aligned with market opportunities and customer needs.

items.title: Financial Planning
items.text: We assist in developing financial plans, revenue projections, budgeting, and cash flow strategies that support informed decision making and long term business stability.

items.title: Market Entry Strategy
items.text: We help businesses identify target markets, evaluate opportunities, and develop effective strategies for successfully entering and expanding into new markets.

items.title: Growth Consulting
items.text: We provide strategic guidance to help businesses optimize performance, overcome growth challenges, and identify opportunities for expansion and long term success.

items.title: Operational Advisory
items.text: We advise founders on improving business operations, enhancing efficiency, and implementing processes that support sustainable business growth.

items.title: Risk Assessment
items.text: We help identify potential business, financial, and operational risks, enabling founders to make informed decisions and build resilient businesses.

services.title: Marketing & Brand Growth
services.alt: Two colleagues planning a growth strategy at a sticky-note board
services.summary: Positioning and growth support to take your brand into the right markets.
lead: Positioning and growth support to take your brand into the right markets.
services.note: Positioning, launch and growth, with visibility across India, the United States and Europe.

items.title: Brand Positioning
items.text: We help founders define a clear brand identity, value proposition, and messaging that set their business apart in competitive markets.

items.title: Go-to-Market Strategy
items.text: We plan product launches and market entry, identifying the right audiences, channels, and timing to reach customers effectively.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.text: We guide founders in building an effective online presence across search, social media, and content to attract and convert customers.

items.title: Market Research & Customer Insights
items.text: We help businesses understand their customers, competitors, and market trends to make informed marketing decisions.

items.title: Growth Campaigns
items.text: We support founders in designing and measuring campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and sustainable revenue growth.

items.title: Partnerships & Visibility
items.text: We connect founders with media, industry, and strategic partners that increase brand visibility across India, the United States, and Europe.
